title: Measured elimination order verification and SAT at fixed intermediate width
claims: MeasuredEliminationWalk checks exactly whether every prefix stage lies in a given universe and returns the canonical final stage on success.
EliminationOrderSAT gives an exact P language of canonical formula, order and universe triples with covered stages and empty final formula.
FullEliminationSAT identifies the final empty formula condition with satisfiability when the order covers all original variables.
MeasuredWidthElimination generates the universe from the formula for any fixed width, verifies the order width, and decides satisfiability on covered complete orders.

experiments.purpose: Bind all archived Lean overlay sources and the recorded exact statements to the local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports its live Lean invocation count, which may be zero.
